BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liquor self-checkout machines; and adding a newsection to chapter 66.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Retailers may not sell any spirits, wine, or beer through aself-checkout machine or system that enables a customer to purchaseitems with limited or no assistance from the retailer or an employee ofthe retailer.
